app.title: SDCC – Small Device C Compiler
app.author: lioeters
app.description: A small device C compiler, cross‑compiler targeting embedded microcontrollers such as the 8‑bit AVR, Z80, and 8051.
proposed_tests: Download source and run ./configure && make && make install
Create a simple hello.c, compile with sdcc -o hello.hex hello.c
Run the generated binary on an emulator and verify output
Measure compilation time for a moderate size C project
